name: @repo/vault
description: VaultManager — the user's local knowledge vault: a single user-selectable folder of markdown files, read through to disk and written atomically, with the ephemeral-listing liveness model (TTL crawl snapshot + ONE non-recursive open-note watcher driven by the pure change classifier). Host callbacks (change notifier, agent-workspace symlink dir, OS trash) are injected by the composing host — this package never imports server/electron/agent code.
